briefings.title: AMI Founder & Chair Yann LeCun at Silicon Valley & The World | Semafor

people.name: Yann LeCun
people.role: Founder and Chair, Advanced Machine Intelligence

briefings.tldr: Yann LeCun, Founder and Chair of Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI), explained why Silicon Valley is overly "LLM-pilled" and detailed his $1 billion seed-funded bet on "world models" and physical AI—funded entirely without Silicon Valley VCs.

briefings.title: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch at Silicon Valley & The World | Semafor
briefings.tldr: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch outlines the company's differentiation as a "sovereign AI" provider—offering portable, zero-trust, on-premise, and open-weight models for critical industrial and financial workflows—while positioning Europe as a vital hedge against US and Chinese AI dependencies ahead of an eventual European IPO.

briefings.title: Fmr. Commerce Sec. Gina Raimondo & Hyundai CEO José Muñoz at Silicon Valley & The World | Semafor
briefings.tldr: Former Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo criticized transactional US chip export policies while introducing RAISE, her $750M non-profit aimed at preventing an AI-driven labor crisis, as Hyundai CEO José Muñoz detailed his company's $26B US investment and pivot into "physical AI" with Waymo, Uber, and Boston Dynamics.
